theme.description: Mix élégant - Cinematic dark hero sections blending seamlessly into clean, premium light content sections. Focus on modern luxury, spiritual depth, and international institutional authority.

rules.headings: Use font-light or font-medium for an editorial, cinematic look. Avoid bold unless necessary.
rules.body: Keep body text highly readable. Use text-white/80 on dark backgrounds, and text-black/80 on light backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-lg (8px) or rounded-md (6px) for subtle, premium geometry. Avoid pill shapes for cards.

header.style: Crystal Glassmorphism on scroll: backdrop-blur-xl bg-charcoal/80 border-b border-white/10. Transparent at top.
header.behavior: Sticky top, Z-50. Navigation items text-white/90 hover:text-gold transition-colors.

hero.content: Centered or Left-aligned, H1 in Cormorant Garamond, subtle staggered fade-up via Framer Motion

buttons.primary: bg-gold text-charcoal px-8 py-3 rounded-md font-semibold hover:bg-gold_light transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-gold/20 hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/30 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-md hover:bg-white/10 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.dark_mode_secondary: bg-transparent border border-black/20 text-charcoal px-8 py-3 rounded-md hover:bg-black/5 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1

cards.event_card: bg-light_card border border-border_light p-6 rounded-lg hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow. Contains 'Upcoming' badge, date, speaker.
cards.video_card: YouTube-style premium thumbnail. overflow-hidden rounded-lg group. Image scales up slightly on hover. Play button overlay fades in.
cards.testimonial_slider: Large airy quotes in Cormorant Garamond. Minimalist navigation arrows. Photos + video pills.

stats.style: Large typography (text-5xl+) for numbers in Cormorant Garamond, paired with small uppercase overlines for labels.

world_map.style: Dark background section (#0B132B) with abstract world map image overlaid. Glowing gold nodes for active countries.

footer.style: bg-charcoal text-white py-24. High contrast. Large brand typography. Newsletter form with minimal inputs (bottom border only).

patterns.reveal: Sections fade in and translate Y (e.g., y: 40 -> 0) on intersection.
patterns.stagger: List items (cards, nav links) stagger in with 0.1s delay.
patterns.hover: Images inside cards scale to 1.05 over 0.6s ease-out. Buttons elevate slightly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Satoshi' via Google Fonts / Fontshare.

Implement the 'Mix élégant' strategy: Home page hero and footer must be dark theme (#0A0A0A or #0B132B), while content sections (like events or about) should transition smoothly into light theme (#F8F9FA).
Use standard Shadcn components for forms, inputs, and complex logic, but style them manually to fit the premium aesthetic.
Do NOT use generic placeholder text. Use realistic French/English bilingual content concepts.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Rely solely on the provided URLs in this JSON file.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for automated testing.
Ensure generous padding/margins (py-24, gap-12) to achieve the 'airy' and 'institutional' feel.
Set up a global state or simple React Context for the FR/EN language switcher if needed, or build the UI for one primary language (EN) with the UI toggle present.
Incorporate framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on text and cards as users scroll down.
